items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: In the big band situations I was playing in the trombone section along with people like Comegys [Leon Comegys].

ctx.x: You played in both a small group and a big band situation with him.

With Dizzy? Both. That is correct. In the big band situations I was playing in the trombone section along with people like Comegys [Leon Comegys]. Yeah. Most of the repertoire was big band versions of Dizzy’s compositions – Birk's Works, Manteca, Con Alma – things like that. They were always well-arranged by persons such as Gil Fuller or Tadd Dameron and people of that ilk.
The small group things included one of the most exciting recordings I remember – that blues in A-flat, The Champ.
